# Total nodes

**216 nodes** across 5 packs. Deprecated nodes are listed but not counted.

| Pack | Nodes | Version | Link |
|---|---|---|---|
| LC123 | 152 | v1.50.0 | [Repo](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes) |
| LC AV | 16 | v0.3.13 | [Repo](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes) |
| LC MaskMaker | 19 | v0.19.8 | [Repo](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_MaskMaker_nodes) |
| LC Vision | 9 | v1.5.1 | [Repo](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes) |
| LC ModelBuilder | 20 | v0.6.1 | [Repo](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes) |

---

## LC123 v1.50.0

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **CivitAI 🚩🔪** | Strips flagged terms from a prompt using a compliance list, as an aid only (you are still responsible for CivitAI's terms). Off until you switch it on. |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | Builds separate filename and path outputs for Image Saver style nodes, with optional prefix-in-path and timestamp. |
| **LC Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | Paint RGB regions on the node and get a separate conditioning and mask for each region, for Anima regional prompting. |
| **LC Any Empty Bool** | Outputs true if any connected input is empty, muted or bypassed. |
| **LC Any Empty Float** | Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty float. |
| **LC Any Empty Int** | Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty integer. |
| **LC Any Index Switch** | Passes through the input at the chosen index and ignores the other slots. |
| **LC AnySwitch** | Picks the first connected input out of 2 to 20 and locks to its type. |
| **LC Apply LoRA Stack 🎚️** | Applies a LORA_STACK from LC LoRA Loader Stack (or any pack) to model and/or clip. |
| **LC Apply LUT** | Applies a .cube 3D LUT from models/luts with a strength from 0 to 2. Starts on LC Crushed Blacks at 0.3. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe (In/Edit)** | Packs image, mask, size, latent, batch and resolution into an LC_PIPE, or edits one, overwriting only the wired sockets. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe Out** | Unpacks the aspect ratio fields of an LC_PIPE into separate sockets and passes the pipe on. |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier** | Resizes an image and/or mask to a target size and outputs image, mask, size, empty latent and batch. |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier (pipe)** | Does the same as the Aspect Ratio Simplifier and adds a pipe output for Get/Set. |
| **LC Auto White Balance** | Corrects white balance automatically with a choice of algorithm, a strength blend and a before/after wipe. |
| **LC Basic Scheduler** | Outputs sigmas for the full step count (no denoise), made to feed LC Split Sigmas (Advanced) for dual-pass sampling. |
| **LC Batch Image 🖼️** | Batches images from auto-growing slots, ignoring muted or missing ones and resizing later images to the first. |
| **LC Bloom** | Adds a glow from the bright areas in Bloom, Pro-Mist (diffusion filter) or Halation (film edge glow) mode. |
| **LC Boolean** | Turns a boolean, int or float into a clean true/false and shows it on the node. |
| **LC Boolean Flip** | Outputs the opposite of its toggle. |
| **LC Boolean Switch** | Picks the on_true or on_false input (any type) based on a boolean. |
| **LC Boolean Value** | A plain boolean toggle you can wire anywhere. |
| **LC Bypass Relay** | Gathers nodes on its left so a hub can mute or bypass all of them together through OPT_CONNECTION. |
| **LC Bypasser** | Bypasses linked nodes from one place with toggles or BOOLEAN inputs. |
| **LC Bypasser Panel** | A widgets-only remote for LC Bypasser, LC Mute or LC Groups Bypasser. |
| **🗒️LC Camera** | Sets camera framing and depth of field for a prompt from distance and angle presets. |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | Shifts the RGB channels apart to fake lens fringing, with pixel amount and direction per channel. |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | Matches an image's colors to a reference (AdaIN / mean-std) with optional skin protection and mask. |
| **🎨LC Color Palette** | Picks a 4 to 6 color palette from a preset or from an image, for use in prompts. |
| **LC Combo Selector** | A dropdown that mirrors the options of another node's combo (sampler, scheduler, etc.) when wired into it. |
| **LC Control Panel 🎛️** | Up to 16 sliders and on/off switches on one node, each on its own output. The gear on a row sets its type (number or boolean), name, range, step and INT or FLOAT. A new row plugged into a number or boolean input copies that input's settings. |
| **LC Custom Combo** | Builds your own list of options and outputs the chosen text and its index. |
| **LC Custom Combo Panel** | A remote control that picks the choice for an LC Custom Combo from another spot. |
| **LC Denoise 💉** | Injects latent noise scaled to 1 minus your denoise value, using the same denoise you give the sampler. |
| **LC Depth FX 🌫️** | Uses a depth map for atmospheric haze, light wrap and depth of field with real bokeh, with shared looks. |
| **LC Detail Daemon (BETA)** | Adds fine detail by hiding a little of the noise from the model over a window of the steps, on the original Detail Daemon schedule. Look only (default), classic and keep structure modes. Sampler version. Goes on the low pass sampler. |
| **LC Detail Daemon (model) (BETA)** | The same Detail Daemon as a model patch, for a plain KSampler. |
| **LC Detail Pipe Out** | Unpacks the detailer settings (models, prompts, seed, cfg, sampler, scheduler, steps) from an LC_PIPE. protect_mask (bottom): the areas the pipe detailers redrew. |
| **LC Dimension Resize 📐** | Adds, subtracts, multiplies or divides width and height by one value and rounds the results to integers. |
| **LC Directional Blur** | Motion blur along one angle and length, set by dragging an arrow on the node. |
| **LC Dynamic Overlay** | Overlays image B on image A and lets you adjust the opacity on the node after one run without regenerating. |
| **LC Easy Folder 📂** | Builds a filename_prefix for the native Save Image node and creates the folders. |
| **LC Film Grain** | Adds film grain with amount, contrast, size and mono or color options. |
| **LC Film Grain (Video) 🎞️** | The same grain for a whole clip: GPU, a few frames at a time, with a progress bar. Grain sized to the video, so it survives compression. |
| **LC Film Stock (B&W)** | Gives a black and white film look from presets with a strength blend. |
| **LC Film Stock (Color)** | Gives a color film look from presets (toe, shoulder, gamma) with a strength blend. |
| **LC Float Compare** | Outputs the larger or smaller of two floats. |
| **LC Get Image 📐** | Reads an image's width, height, megapixels, longer side, batch size and aspect ratio. |
| **LC Groups Bypasser** | Bypasses whole groups from one place, with one toggle per group. |
| **LC Image Adjust** | Basic color grade (hue, saturation, brightness, contrast) with a mild sharpen or soften. |
| **LC Image Batch From Folder 📂** | Loads a whole folder as one batch in alphabetical order, with max_images and start_index. |
| **LC Image Compare 🔎** | Compares large batches of images with a compact dropdown and a stable image area. |
| **LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪** | Crops by dragging a box and handles on the node, with an optional aspect lock. |
| **LC Image Denoise** | Smart denoise with blur strength, edge preservation and a blend. |
| **LC Image Desaturate** | Desaturates toward grayscale with a factor and a luminance method. |
| **LC Image Grid 🖼️** | Arranges a batch of images into a grid with optional gap, outline and border. |
| **LC Image Label** | A floating image sticker with drag-and-drop upload for annotating a workflow (no sockets). |
| **LC Image Pass** | Passes an image straight through, and its enable switch mutes what hangs off it downstream. |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe In 🖼️** | Bundles up to 16 reference images into one pipe, with sockets that grow like Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1. |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe Out 🖼️** | Unpacks an image ref pipe back into image_1 to image_16 in their original slots, pipe first. |
| **LC Image RGB** | Offsets each color channel separately with an overall strength. |
| **LC Image Split 🖼️** | A before/after wipe on the node whose output is the baked split for saving. |
| **LC Image Stitch Multi 🖼️🪡** | Stitches images side by side or stacked from autogrow slots, with match size, align and an optional gap. |
| **LC Image to Total Megapixels 📐** | Scales an image to a total megapixel count and outputs the resulting resolution. |
| **LC Image-Mask Resize 📐** | Resizes an image and/or mask to a preset, custom size, multiplier or megapixel count, in multiples of divisible_by. |
| **LC Int Compare** | Outputs the larger or smaller of two integers. |
| **LC Int Split** | Splits a total into a + b at a fractional split point, so a + b always equals the total. |
| **LC Invert Boolean** | Coerces a boolean, int or float and outputs the opposite. |
| **LC Is Bypassed / Muted** | Outputs true if the node wired into it is bypassed or muted, read live without queuing. |
| **LC Join Strings 🔗** | Joins multiple strings with a delimiter and skips the empty ones. |
| **LC Krea2 Regional Inline Canvas** | Paint RGB regions on the node and get regional conditioning using the krea2 CLIP type. |
| **LC Label 🏷️** | A floating text label for annotating a workflow, with fonts, color, outline and shadow (no sockets). |
| **LC Last Image Holder** | Keeps the last generated image for before/after comparison, even after disconnecting. Hold until seed change keeps the first image of a seed to compare tweaks against. |
| **LC Lens FX (deprecated)** | Hidden from search. Old workflows still run it. Use Lens Profile, Vignette and Film Grain instead. |
| **LC Lens Profile** | Applies or corrects a named lens profile with adjustable strength. |
| **LC Lift Gamma Gain** | Grades shadows, midtones and highlights with lift, gamma, gain and offset. |
| **🗒️LC Lighting** | Sets lighting style and direction for a prompt from presets plus your own notes. |
| **LC Lighting Control 🔦 (deprecated)** | Old workflows still run it. Use LC Lighting Control V2 instead. |
| **LC Lighting Control V2 🔦** | Relights an image with one or two spot or sun lights, warmth, color gels and hard or soft cast shadows. |
| **LC LoRA Loader 🎚️** | Applies any number of LoRAs from one node, with enable, strength and drag-to-reorder per row. |
| **LC LoRA Loader Stack 🎚️** | Builds the same LoRA list as LC LoRA Loader, output as a LORA_STACK. |
| **LC Mask Pass** | Passes a mask through, and turning it off makes downstream nodes run with no mask (full frame). |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe** | Packs or edits an H3 pipe holding the prompts, references and settings for MiniMax H3. |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe Out** | Unpacks an LC MiniMax H3 pipe into its separate sockets. |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe Out V2** | Unpacks an H3 pipe V2, adding prompt, steps, cfg, seed, sampler and scheduler outputs. |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe V2** | Packs or edits an H3 pipe V2, which also carries prompt, steps, cfg, seed, sampler and scheduler. |
| **LC Model Info ℹ️** | Wire any MODEL in: it follows the wire upstream (LoRA loaders, merges, LC Model Optimizer) and reads each file's header only. Shows the workflow a save node baked in (base models, LoRAs with strengths, merges), Kohya training info and trigger tags, card fields, GGUF type. Live on the node, no queue needed. The model passes through. |
| **LC Model Optimizer ⚡** | Loads the model, text encoder and VAE that suit your card, with the speed-ups that work on it. Downloads recommended files on the first run. Covers Krea 2 (Turbo and Raw), SDXL, Illustrious, Pony and more, plus Custom for any other model. |
| **LC Model Optimizer (pipe) ⚡** | The same as LC Model Optimizer, plus an LC_PIPE out (model 2 carries Ideogram 4's second model). |
| **LC Model Optimizer Video ⚡** | The video version: model, text encoder, video and audio VAE and latent upscaler for MiniMax H3 and LTX 2.5 / 2.3. |
| **LC Model Optimizer Video (pipe) ⚡** | The same as LC Model Optimizer Video, plus an LC_PIPE out (vae 2 carries the audio VAE). |
| **LC Mute** | Works like LC Bypasser, but Off mutes the linked nodes instead of bypassing them. |
| **LC Natural Look 🍃** | Takes the AI look out: pulls back only the loudest colours, calms orange and plastic skin, rolls the highlights off, cuts the glossy glow and lifts fine texture, with your black point, contrast and brightness kept and a whisper of grain. |
| **LC Negative** | A negative prompt text box. |
| **LC Node Snapshot 📋** | Reads another node's widgets and outputs the selected value, all lines, or JSON. |
| **LC Note 📝** | A markdown note that translates into ComfyUI's 14 languages on click through LC Vision, and shows @[card](link) lines as link cards. |
| **LC Notify 🔊** | Plays a chosen sound when the node runs (always, on empty queue, or never). |
| **LC Phone Filters 📱** | 37 phone-app filter presets (1977, Aden, Brooklyn, etc.) with strength and an on-node wipe. |
| **LC Photo Style 📷** | Gives an image a phone-camera look from a style preset, with sliders and a strength blend. |
| **LC Pipe (in/edit)** | Packs values into an LC_PIPE, or merges overrides into an existing pipe. |
| **LC Pipe Combine** | Edits the top pipe with a second pipe: whatever the edit pipe carries overwrites the top one, everything else rides along. |
| **LC Pipe Out** | Expands an LC_PIPE into individual sockets and passes the pipe on. protect_mask (bottom): the areas the pipe detailers redrew. |
| **LC Preview Image 🖼️** | Previews an image and sits quietly instead of erroring when nothing arrives. |
| **LC Preview Mask 🎭** | Previews a mask and sits quietly instead of erroring when nothing arrives. |
| **🧩LC Prompt Assembler** | Assembles the prompt builder pieces (subject, camera, lighting, style, scene) into one prompt or JSON. |
| **LC Prompt to Conditioning + Zero** | Encodes a prompt into conditioning and also outputs a zeroed copy for the negative. |
| **LC Reference Latent** | Attaches up to eight reference latents to conditioning. |
| **LC RTX Super Resolution ⚡** | NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution on pictures or video frames: upscale up to 4x, upscale a clean source, denoise or deblur. Quality LOW to ULTRA, scale or megapixels, strength. Shows an Install RTX support button when nvidia-vfx is missing. |
| **LC Sampler Configure** | Central dual-pass sampler settings: steps, swap point, detailer steps, denoise, CFGs, sampler and scheduler. |
| **LC Sampler Configure (pipe)** | Dual-pass sampler settings with an optional pipe in and a pipe out. |
| **LC Sampler Configure Pipe Out** | Unpacks an LC_PIPE into the sampler configure sockets, plus the latent. |
| **LC Sampler Configure Simple** | Single-pass sampler settings with one CFG and no step swap. |
| **LC Sampler Configure Simple (pipe)** | Simple sampler settings that read from and write to an LC_PIPE. |
| **LC Sampler Scheduler ⚙️** | Pick the sampler and scheduler once and wire them to every KSampler, so they all change together. |
| **LC Save Image 💾** | Saves images with workflow metadata, and CivitAI parameters when paired with LC Save Metadata. |
| **LC Save Metadata 🏷️** | Builds the metadata (models, AIR or URL, settings) that LC Save Image writes. |
| **📝 LC Save Text** | Writes a text string to a file in the output folder. |
| **🗒️LC Scene Builder** | Builds a scene description from scene presets and objects. |
| **🌱LC Seed** | A utility seed with a mode that also works when you queue only this node. |
| **LC Seed Jump 🌱** | Takes a seed and a jump value and outputs the seed plus five successive jumps. |
| **LC Sharpen Pro** | Undoes softness (deconvolution) with texture and clarity, halo control and skin protection. Presets for photos, line art, anime and illustration. |
| **LC Show Any 🔤** | Shows any value on the node and passes it through with its type unchanged. |
| **LC Show Text 🔤** | Shows a string on the node and passes it on. |
| **LC Sigma Curve** | Draw a custom sigma curve on the node, save it, and reuse it. |
| **LC Sigma Resample** | Resamples a sigma curve to a new step count while keeping its start and end sigma (also registered as LCChangeStepCount). |
| **LC Sigmas (BETA)** | One scheduler for one- and two-pass sampling: sigma curve presets (base, beta, flowmatch, hyperbolic, gaussian, your saved curves) you can bend by dragging the graph, step swap, denoise, continue or renoise on the second pass, and sigma shift. Takes regular and RES4LYF / ClownShark sampler names. |
| **LC Size Pad 📐** | A 2D slider for width x height: drag the frame's corner. Model presets (MiniMax H3, Krea 2, SDXL, LTX, Klein 9B, Wan 2.2) snap to the model's step and stop at its megapixel limit; aspect lock and portrait / landscape flip. |
| **LC Skin Beauty ✨** | Cools, brightens and evens skin in LAB with presets, protecting highlights, with an optional mask. Runs on GPU or CPU. |
| **LC Skin Texture ✨ (BETA)** | Adds real pore texture to skin that came out too smooth, from a real skin photo (only its fine relief, never its colour). Optional protect_mask leaves the detailers' areas alone. |
| **LC Skin Upscale** | Upscales only the masked skin area with a CNN model and blends it back. Optional protect_mask leaves the detailers' areas alone. |
| **LC Slider** | A slider on the node face that outputs an int or float. |
| **LC Speed Boost (BETA) 🚀** | About 2x faster sampling (about 1.4x on SDXL / Pony / Illustrious), same quality: the picture starts at half size and grows to full size partway through. Plug it into the high pass sampler. |
| **LC Speed Boost 🚀 KSampler (BETA)** | A KSampler with Speed Boost built in. Same inputs, plus start / end at step so it can chain into another sampler. Takes ClownShark (RES4LYF) samplers. |
| **LC Split Sigma Scheduler** | Splits sigmas between two models for a dual-model SamplerCustomAdvanced. |
| **LC Split Sigmas (Advanced)** | Splits sigma curves at a swap step into a high and a low set. |
| **LC Stop 🛑** | A queue breakpoint you can enable to pause until you continue. |
| **🗒️LC Style Selector** | Picks a style preset (and quality level) for a prompt and adds your own notes. |
| **🗒️LC Subject** | Describes the subject of a prompt with freeform text plus pose, action, outfit and placement options. |
| **🗒️LC Subject Array** | Combines several subject outputs into one line. |
| **LC Text Overlay** | Draws text on an image with a draggable position, font size and color. |
| **LC Text Remove 🔪** | Removes up to twenty substrings from a text, in order. |
| **LC ✂️ Duplicate Tags 🏷️** | Removes repeated tags so none gets double weight (long_hair = (long hair:1.2)). Optional second prompt to merge two and clean them together. |
| **LC 🚦** | A light for a boolean: one color for true, one for false (or none). Colors behind the gear. |
| **LC Text Replace ✂️** | Runs up to twenty find and replace pairs (optionally regex) on a text. |
| **LC Timer ⏱️** | Times every run and scores the newest one against the 5 before it: faster in green, slower in red. Lists the last 10 runs. Stopped and fully cached runs are left out. |
| **LC Tone Match** | Keeps the reference's broad lighting and color while keeping the image's fine detail, with an optional mask. |
| **LC Vibrance** | Smart saturation (vibrance) with optional plain saturation and skin protection. |
| **LC Vignette** | Darkens or brightens the edges of the image. |
| **LC VRAM Cache Clear** | A pass-through node that clears GPU and model cache when it runs, also on its own branch with nothing after it. |
| **LC Watermark 💧** | Composites a watermark image you position by dragging, with live size and opacity. Transparent PNGs keep their transparency through watermark_mask. |
| **LC Widget To String** | Reads a widget on another node as a string. |
| **🎲LC Wildcard** | Picks a random line from a wildcard text file. |
| **Prompt** | A prompt text box (was LC Positive). The Vision Assistant swaps it in for other packs' text boxes, or LC Negative when the box feeds a negative. |
| **Prompt to Conditioning** | Encodes a text prompt into CLIP conditioning. |

---

## LC AV v0.3.13

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Audio Channel 🎚️** | Splits stereo audio into left and right, and duplicates mono to both. |
| **LC Audio Crop ✂️** | Crops audio from a start time to an end time (MM:SS). |
| **LC Audio Duration ⏱️** | Outputs the audio length as seconds and minutes, as int and float. |
| **LC Audio EQ 3-Band 🎛️** | A 3-band equalizer with a low shelf, a peaking mid and a high shelf. |
| **LC Audio Separate 🎼** | Splits audio into Bass, Drums, Other and Vocals stems with Hybrid Demucs. |
| **LC Audio Volume 🔊** | Changes audio volume with a slider and soft-clips after the gain. |
| **LC AV Pipe (in/edit) 🎬** | Packs or edits an LC_AV_PIPE holding video, audio and settings. |
| **LC AV Pipe Out 🎬** | Unpacks an LC_AV_PIPE into its slots and passes the av_pipe on. |
| **LC Create Video 🎬** | Builds an LC_AV_PIPE from an image batch (it does not encode a file). |
| **LC Final Frame 🖼️** | Outputs the last frame of an image batch. |
| **LC Get Latent Size 📐** | Reads the pixel width and height of a latent, plus batch and frames for video latents. |
| **LC Load Audio 📂** | Loads audio from the input folder with start and end trim and a preview player. |
| **LC Pipe → AV Pipe 🔌** | Converts an LC_PIPE or MiniMax H3 pipe into an LC_AV_PIPE, copying only the shared fields. |
| **LC Save Video Metadata 🏷️** | Builds the same metadata as LC Save Metadata, for LC Save Image or LC Save Video. |
| **LC Save Video 💾** | Saves video with Video Combine style options (frame rate, loop, format, pingpong, crf, pix_fmt, audio). |
| **LC VAE Decode 🧩** | A VAE Decode with a switch between full and tiled decoding. |

## LC MaskMaker v0.19.8

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_MaskMaker_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_MaskMaker_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Auto Adjust 🔆** | One-click auto levels (per channel, luminance, saturation or mono) with trims, a strength blend and an optional mask. |
| **LC Create Mask 🖼️✏️** | Draws a mask right on the node with points or a freehand pencil, with feather, invert and opacity built in. |
| **LC Depth Anything V2 🌊** | Makes a Depth Anything V2 depth map (bright = near) as an image and a mask. Model list reads the same on every machine. |
| **LC Face Crop 📐** | Crops to a format with the faces placed well instead of a blind centre crop, using the Aspect Ratio Simplifier presets. Framing from widest to face only. |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | Places a layer on a background (position, scale, rotate, mirror) and blends it with 29 blend modes through an optional mask. |
| **LC Outpaint, Rotate, & Pad 🔄** | Turn, crop and pad a picture by dragging on the node, with a portrait / landscape flip. The mask covers the padding and the corners a turn opens up. max_megapixels stops the frame at that size. |
| **LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹** | Krea 2 inpaint and outpaint with the AnyPaint LoRA. Everything outside the mask comes back exactly as it was, and the seam disappears. |
| **LC Z-Image AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for Z-Image (Turbo / Base), painted by the Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1 patch instead of a LoRA. Everything outside the mask comes back exactly as it was. |
| **LC SDXL AnyPaint 🩹** | The same inpaint and outpaint for any SDXL checkpoint (SDXL, Pony, Illustrious), painted by ControlNet Union ProMax, Fooocus inpaint optional. No LoRA needed. |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | Tightens a mask with a trimap, using a guided filter or VITMatte on the edge band only, with a before/after wipe. |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | Makes a BAE surface normal map (RGB = XYZ), the same style ControlNet's normal_bae makes. |
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | Drag the canvas edges outward on the node to build a grey canvas and a mask of the new area. max_megapixels stops the edges at that size. |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | Selects parts of a person (face, hair, body, clothes, accessories, background) with Segformer or MediaPipe. remove_features makes a skin-only mask. |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | Removes the background with BiRefNet and outputs an RGBA cutout, the mask and the subject on a solid color. |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | Selects things by describing them, using GroundingDINO + SAM or SAM 3, with optional edge refine. |
| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | Replaces the SEGS / Impact detailers. Finds what you type (hands, face, eyes) with SAM 3 and redraws each one in its own upscaled crop, then blends it back in. |
| **LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹** | The same, with model, VAE and sampler settings from the LC pipe. A wired model or VAE overrides the pipe's. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | Fast, low-VRAM upscale with VOSR 2.0, built in: sharpens and adds fine detail without redrawing the picture. 1.5x to 4x in one pass, 6x and 8x in two. |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩** | The same on the LC pipe, after the pipe detailers. Carries the detailers' areas to the new size (protected output) for LC Skin Upscale / LC Skin Texture. |

## LC Vision v1.5.1

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Vision Director (BETA) 🎬** | Plans a long MiniMax H3 video as a chain of CUT / CONTINUE segments with one shared style block, made one per Run by the LC H3 Segment nodes. Saves the plan and reuses it. |
| **LC Vision Reviewer 🕵️ (BETA)** | Quality gate: yes/no checks on hands, faces, text, artifacts, prompt match and your own questions. Flags a bad render, or blocks everything after it. |
| **LC Vision Shot List (BETA) 📋** | The story for the Director, filled in like a form: the place, the cast and one row per shot. Suggests the segment count and warns about lines too long for their shot. No AI involved. |
| **LC Vision Redirect (BETA) 🔬** | Looks at how the last segment really ended and rewrites the start of the next one to match, so nobody teleports at the join. |
| **LC Vision Danbooru Caption 🏷️** | Prompts for SDXL, Pony and Illustrious from one image or a rough idea: a short or detailed caption, real Danbooru tags, or a sentence plus tags. Optional quality tags and a matching negative. |
| **LC Vision Caption 📝** | Generates text from a loaded LC Vision model, an instruction, up to three reference images and a reference video. |
| **LC Vision Loader 🔬** | Loads a Qwen-VL GGUF model and its vision projector. keep_model_loaded off unloads it after the Vision nodes are done, so the image model gets the whole card. |
| **LC Vision Moviemaker 🎥** | Plans a video as several continuous segments in one call, each written as a self-contained MiniMax H3 prompt. |
| **LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝** | Rewrites a prompt through an LC Vision model using a preset instruction (text only). |

## LC ModelBuilder v0.6.1

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes)

| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| **LC Checkpoint Save** | Saves an all-in-one checkpoint (model, clip, vae) with an enabled toggle to skip the save. metadata: keep all, or necessary only (no workflow or training details). |
| **LC Diffusion Model Save** | Saves just the diffusion model, with no clip or vae. Same metadata switch. |
| **LC Face Variety Scorer 🧑‍🤝‍🧑** | Scores how alike the faces in a batch are (0 to 1, lower = more variety), plus a crowd score for group shots. Photo (ArcFace) or anime (CCIP) mode. |
| **LC Fingerprint Identify 🔎** | What is this model made of? Its recipe from your fingerprint library, block by block: which models were merged and at what ratio, merged-in LoRAs with their strength, how sure it is of each, and a heatmap. It can only name what is in the library. |
| **LC Fingerprint Library 📚** | Goes through your folders and stores a small fingerprint (about 1 MB) of every model and LoRA, with its family. Once a file is in, the original can go. Reruns only add what is new. |
| **LC Krea2 Block Merge Advanced** | Merges Krea2 checkpoints with a draggable per-block ratio curve across the 28 blocks plus sliders for the named regions. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Block Scan** | Finds where a LoRA locks the face or changes the whole image by turning off one block group at a time, and suggests a block curve for the Editor. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Editor** | Loads a Krea 2 LoRA with each of the 28 blocks turned up or down, attention and MLP scaled separately, and spikes softened. |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Merge** | Merges two to four Krea 2 LoRAs with a per-block A / B curve (sum or TIES). |
| **LC Krea2 Semantic Vector Tuner** | Amplifies or attenuates specific regions of a single Krea2 checkpoint's weights (not a merge). |
| **LC LoRA Extract** | Turns a finetune into a LoRA (finetuned minus its base): all layers, blocks only or a custom block list. Unchanged layers are left out. |
| **LC LoRA Save** | Saves an edited or merged LoRA as a standard file with every edit baked in, optionally at a new rank, with enabled and embed_workflow switches. |
| **LC Model Fingerprint 🔍** | One model against a reference, layer by layer, from the weights themselves: the same model at another precision, built on it, a block merge (the chart shows which blocks) or not related. With a LoRA: whether it was merged in and at about what strength. |
| **LC Model Quantize 🗜️** | Saves a smaller copy of a model: fp8, mxfp8, nvfp4, int8 or int4 (load with the stock loader) or GGUF Q8_0 to Q2_K. From the wired MODEL (LoRAs baked in) or straight from a file of any size. |
| **LC Model Merge (any precision)** | Merges two models stored in different precisions (bf16 with fp8, int8, nvfp4 or GGUF, in either order). The result stays full precision. |
| **LC Scoreboard 🏆** | Head-to-head counter for A / B tests: #1 Win, Tie and #2 Win buttons, with the leader and percentages shown on the node. |
| **LC Strip Metadata 🧹** | Cleans the metadata out of a model you already saved (embedded workflow, training details, titles). The weights are copied byte for byte, never loaded, so it loads exactly as before. Writes a _clean copy or replaces the original. |
| **LC VAE Compare** | Decodes the same latents with up to six VAEs, side by side with a 1:1 detail crop, a sharpness number and how far each lands from the first. |
| **LC VAE Merge** | Merges the decoders of two VAEs of the same family, coarse shapes to fine texture. The encoder stays the base's, so the result still fits the models made for it. |
| **LC VAE Save** | Saves a VAE to models/vae in fp32, bf16 or fp16. |

# 节点总数

5 个包共 **216 个节点**。已弃用的节点会列出，但不计入总数。

| 包 | 节点数 | 版本 | 链接 |
|---|---|---|---|
| LC123 | 152 | v1.50.0 | [仓库](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes) |
| LC AV | 16 | v0.3.13 | [仓库](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes) |
| LC MaskMaker | 19 | v0.19.8 | [仓库](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_MaskMaker_nodes) |
| LC Vision | 9 | v1.5.1 | [仓库](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes) |
| LC ModelBuilder | 20 | v0.6.1 | [仓库](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes) |

---

## LC123 v1.50.0

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

| 节点 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **CivitAI 🚩🔪** | 使用合规列表从提示词中剔除被标记的词，仅作辅助（你仍需对 CivitAI 的条款负责）。你打开之前默认关闭。 |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | 为 Image Saver 类节点生成独立的文件名和路径输出，可选在路径中加前缀和时间戳。 |
| **LC Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | 在节点上绘制 RGB 区域，为每个区域得到单独的 conditioning 和 mask，用于 Anima 区域提示。 |
| **LC Any Empty Bool** | 只要有任何已连接的输入为空、被静音或被 bypass，就输出 true。 |
| **LC Any Empty Float** | 执行与 Any Empty Bool 相同的判空，并输出一个"空"和一个"非空"的 float。 |
| **LC Any Empty Int** | 执行与 Any Empty Bool 相同的判空，并输出一个"空"和一个"非空"的整数。 |
| **LC Any Index Switch** | 透传所选索引处的输入，忽略其他槽位。 |
| **LC AnySwitch** | 从 2 到 20 个输入中选取第一个已连接的，并锁定为其类型。 |
| **LC Apply LoRA Stack 🎚️** | 把 LC LoRA Loader Stack（或任何包）输出的 LORA_STACK 应用到 model 和/或 clip。 |
| **LC Apply LUT** | 应用 models/luts 中的 .cube 3D LUT，强度 0 到 2。默认以 0.3 的强度启用 LC Crushed Blacks。 |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe (In/Edit)** | 把图像、mask、尺寸、latent、批量和分辨率打包进 LC_PIPE，或编辑已有的 pipe，只覆盖接了线的接口。 |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe Out** | 把 LC_PIPE 的宽高比字段拆成单独的接口，并继续传递 pipe。 |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier** | 把图像和/或 mask 缩放到目标尺寸，输出图像、mask、尺寸、空 latent 和批量。 |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier (pipe)** | 与 Aspect Ratio Simplifier 功能相同，并增加一个 pipe 输出用于 Get/Set。 |
| **LC Auto White Balance** | 自动校正白平衡，可选算法、混合强度，并带前后对比滑动。 |
| **LC Basic Scheduler** | 输出完整步数的 sigmas（不含 denoise），用来喂给 LC Split Sigmas (Advanced) 做双段采样。 |
| **LC Batch Image 🖼️** | 从自动增长的槽位合并图像为批量，忽略被静音或缺失的，并把后面的图像缩放到与第一张一致。 |
| **LC Bloom** | 从明亮区域生成光晕，有 Bloom、Pro-Mist（柔光滤镜）或 Halation（胶片边缘光晕）模式。 |
| **LC Boolean** | 把 boolean、int 或 float 转成干净的 true/false，并显示在节点上。 |
| **LC Boolean Flip** | 输出其开关的相反值。 |
| **LC Boolean Switch** | 根据 boolean 选择 on_true 或 on_false 输入（任意类型）。 |
| **LC Boolean Value** | 一个可以接到任何地方的普通 boolean 开关。 |
| **LC Bypass Relay** | 汇集其左侧的节点，让中枢通过 OPT_CONNECTION 一起静音或 bypass 它们。 |
| **LC Bypasser** | 用开关或 BOOLEAN 输入，在一处 bypass 已连接的节点。 |
| **LC Bypasser Panel** | 仅含控件的遥控器，用于 LC Bypasser、LC Mute 或 LC Groups Bypasser。 |
| **🗒️LC Camera** | 根据距离和角度预设，为提示词设置相机取景和景深。 |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | 错开 RGB 通道来模拟镜头色边，可按通道设置像素量和方向。 |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | 将图像的颜色匹配到参考图（AdaIN / mean-std），可选皮肤保护和 mask。 |
| **🎨LC Color Palette** | 从预设或图像中选取 4 到 6 种颜色的调色板，用于提示词。 |
| **LC Combo Selector** | 一个下拉菜单，接入另一个节点的 combo（sampler、scheduler 等）时会镜像其选项。 |
| **LC Control Panel 🎛️** | 一个节点上最多 16 个滑块和开关，各有自己的输出。每行的齿轮可设置类型（数字或 boolean）、名称、范围、步长以及 INT 或 FLOAT。接到数字或 boolean 输入上的新行会复制该输入的设置。 |
| **LC Custom Combo** | 构建你自己的选项列表，输出所选文本及其索引。 |
| **LC Custom Combo Panel** | 遥控器，可以在别处为 LC Custom Combo 选择选项。 |
| **LC Denoise 💉** | 注入按 1 减去 denoise 值缩放的 latent 噪声，使用与采样器相同的 denoise。 |
| **LC Depth FX 🌫️** | 使用深度图实现大气雾、light wrap 和带真实散景的景深，共享 looks。 |
| **LC Detail Daemon (BETA)** | 在若干步数的窗口内向模型隐藏一部分噪声来增加精细细节，沿用原版 Detail Daemon 的调度。有 look only（默认）、classic 和 keep structure 模式。Sampler 版本。放在 low pass sampler 上。 |
| **LC Detail Daemon (model) (BETA)** | 同样的 Detail Daemon，以 model patch 形式提供，用于普通 KSampler。 |
| **LC Detail Pipe Out** | 从 LC_PIPE 中取出 detailer 设置（模型、提示词、seed、cfg、sampler、scheduler、steps）。protect_mask（底部）：pipe detailers 重绘过的区域。 |
| **LC Dimension Resize 📐** | 用一个值对宽和高做加、减、乘或除，并把结果取整。 |
| **LC Directional Blur** | 沿一个角度和长度的运动模糊，通过拖动节点上的箭头设置。 |
| **LC Dynamic Overlay** | 把图像 B 叠加在图像 A 上，运行一次之后可以直接在节点上调整不透明度，无需重新生成。 |
| **LC Easy Folder 📂** | 为原生 Save Image 节点生成 filename_prefix 并创建文件夹。 |
| **LC Film Grain** | 添加胶片颗粒，可调数量、对比度、大小，以及单色或彩色选项。 |
| **LC Film Grain (Video) 🎞️** | 为整段视频添加同样的颗粒：GPU 处理，每次几帧，带进度条。颗粒大小按视频尺寸来定，所以压缩后仍然保留。 |
| **LC Film Stock (B&W)** | 通过预设和混合强度，获得黑白胶片的质感。 |
| **LC Film Stock (Color)** | 通过预设（toe、shoulder、gamma）和混合强度，获得彩色胶片的质感。 |
| **LC Float Compare** | 输出两个 float 中较大或较小的一个。 |
| **LC Get Image 📐** | 读取图像的宽、高、百万像素、长边、批量大小和宽高比。 |
| **LC Groups Bypasser** | 在一处 bypass 整个分组，每个分组一个开关。 |
| **LC Image Adjust** | 基础调色（色相、饱和度、亮度、对比度），带轻微的锐化或柔化。 |
| **LC Image Batch From Folder 📂** | 按字母顺序把整个文件夹加载为一个批量，带 max_images 和 start_index。 |
| **LC Image Compare 🔎** | 用紧凑的下拉菜单和稳定的图像区域比较大批量的图像。 |
| **LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪** | 通过拖动节点上的框和手柄来裁剪，可选锁定宽高比。 |
| **LC Image Denoise** | 智能去噪，带模糊强度、边缘保留和混合。 |
| **LC Image Desaturate** | 按系数和亮度方法向灰度去饱和。 |
| **LC Image Grid 🖼️** | 把一批图像排成网格，可选间距、轮廓和边框。 |
| **LC Image Label** | 浮动的图片贴纸，支持拖放上传，用于给工作流做标注（没有接口）。 |
| **LC Image Pass** | 让图像直接通过，它的启用开关会把下游挂在它后面的东西静音。 |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe In 🖼️** | 把最多 16 张参考图打包进一个 pipe，接口像 Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1 一样自动增长。 |
| **LC Image Ref Pipe Out 🖼️** | 把图像参考 pipe 拆回 image_1 到 image_16 的原始槽位，pipe 在最前。 |
| **LC Image RGB** | 分别偏移每个颜色通道，并带有整体强度。 |
| **LC Image Split 🖼️** | 节点上的前后对比滑动，输出是可保存的合成分割图。 |
| **LC Image Stitch Multi 🖼️🪡** | 从自动增长的槽位把图像并排或上下拼接，带 match size、对齐和可选间距。 |
| **LC Image to Total Megapixels 📐** | 把图像缩放到指定的总百万像素数，并输出得到的分辨率。 |
| **LC Image-Mask Resize 📐** | 把图像和/或 mask 缩放到预设、自定义尺寸、倍数或百万像素数，按 divisible_by 的倍数取整。 |
| **LC Int Compare** | 输出两个整数中较大或较小的一个。 |
| **LC Int Split** | 按小数分割点把总数拆成 a + b，使 a + b 始终等于总数。 |
| **LC Invert Boolean** | 转换 boolean、int 或 float，并输出相反值。 |
| **LC Is Bypassed / Muted** | 如果接入的节点被 bypass 或静音就输出 true，实时读取，无需排队运行。 |
| **LC Join Strings 🔗** | 用分隔符连接多个字符串，并跳过空的。 |
| **LC Krea2 Regional Inline Canvas** | 在节点上绘制 RGB 区域，使用 krea2 CLIP 类型得到区域 conditioning。 |
| **LC Label 🏷️** | 浮动的文字标签，用于给工作流做标注，支持字体、颜色、描边和阴影（没有接口）。 |
| **LC Last Image Holder** | 保留最后生成的图像用于前后对比，即使断开连接后也在。Hold until seed change 会保留某个 seed 的第一张图，用来与调整后的结果比较。 |
| **LC Lens FX (deprecated)** | 在搜索中隐藏。旧工作流仍然能运行它。请改用 Lens Profile、Vignette 和 Film Grain。 |
| **LC Lens Profile** | 应用或校正指定的镜头配置，强度可调。 |
| **LC Lift Gamma Gain** | 用 lift、gamma、gain 和 offset 调整阴影、中间调和高光。 |
| **🗒️LC Lighting** | 根据预设加上你自己的备注，为提示词设置光照风格和方向。 |
| **LC Lighting Control 🔦 (deprecated)** | 旧工作流仍然能运行它。请改用 LC Lighting Control V2。 |
| **LC Lighting Control V2 🔦** | 用一到两个聚光或日光灯、色温、色片以及硬或软投影阴影给图像重新打光。 |
| **LC LoRA Loader 🎚️** | 一个节点应用任意数量的 LoRA，每行都有启用、强度和拖动排序。 |
| **LC LoRA Loader Stack 🎚️** | 构建与 LC LoRA Loader 相同的 LoRA 列表，输出为 LORA_STACK。 |
| **LC Mask Pass** | 让 mask 通过，关闭它则下游节点会在没有 mask 的情况下运行（全画面）。 |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe** | 打包或编辑 H3 pipe，其中包含 MiniMax H3 的提示词、参考和设置。 |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe Out** | 把 LC MiniMax H3 pipe 拆成单独的接口。 |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe Out V2** | 拆开 H3 pipe V2，额外增加 prompt、steps、cfg、seed、sampler 和 scheduler 输出。 |
| **LC MiniMax H3 Pipe V2** | 打包或编辑 H3 pipe V2，它还携带 prompt、steps、cfg、seed、sampler 和 scheduler。 |
| **LC Model Info ℹ️** | 接入任意 MODEL：它会沿着连线向上游追溯（LoRA 加载器、merge、LC Model Optimizer），只读取每个文件的头部。显示保存节点写入的工作流（基础模型、带强度的 LoRA、merge）、Kohya 训练信息和触发词、模型卡字段、GGUF 类型。直接在节点上实时显示，无需排队运行。模型照常通过。 |
| **LC Model Optimizer ⚡** | 加载适合你显卡的模型、文本编码器和 VAE，并附带在它上面可用的加速项。首次运行时下载推荐文件。涵盖 Krea 2（Turbo 和 Raw）、SDXL、Illustrious、Pony 等，另有 Custom 用于任何其他模型。 |
| **LC Model Optimizer (pipe) ⚡** | 与 LC Model Optimizer 相同，另外有 LC_PIPE 输出（model 2 携带 Ideogram 4 的第二个模型）。 |
| **LC Model Optimizer Video ⚡** | 视频版本：用于 MiniMax H3 和 LTX 2.5 / 2.3 的模型、文本编码器、视频和音频 VAE 以及 latent 放大器。 |
| **LC Model Optimizer Video (pipe) ⚡** | 与 LC Model Optimizer Video 相同，另外有 LC_PIPE 输出（vae 2 携带音频 VAE）。 |
| **LC Mute** | 与 LC Bypasser 类似，但 Off 是把已连接的节点静音，而不是 bypass。 |
| **LC Natural Look 🍃** | 去掉 AI 味：只拉回最刺眼的颜色，缓和橙色和塑料感皮肤，让高光自然过渡，减弱油亮的光泽并提升精细质感，保留你的黑点、对比度和亮度，再加一丝颗粒。 |
| **LC Negative** | 负面提示词文本框。 |
| **LC Node Snapshot 📋** | 读取另一个节点的控件，输出所选的值、所有行或 JSON。 |
| **LC Note 📝** | Markdown 备注，点击即可通过 LC Vision 翻译成 ComfyUI 的 14 种语言，并把 @[card](link) 行显示为链接卡片。 |
| **LC Notify 🔊** | 节点运行时播放选定的声音（总是、队列为空时、或从不）。 |
| **LC Phone Filters 📱** | 37 种手机 App 滤镜预设（1977、Aden、Brooklyn 等），带强度和节点上的滑动对比。 |
| **LC Photo Style 📷** | 通过风格预设、滑块和混合强度，赋予图像手机相机的质感。 |
| **LC Pipe (in/edit)** | 把值打包成 LC_PIPE，或者把覆盖项合并进已有的 pipe。 |
| **LC Pipe Combine** | 用第二个 pipe 编辑顶部的 pipe：edit pipe 里带的内容会覆盖顶部的，其余的原样保留。 |
| **LC Pipe Out** | 把 LC_PIPE 展开成单独的接口，并继续传递 pipe。protect_mask（底部）：pipe detailers 重绘过的区域。 |
| **LC Preview Image 🖼️** | 预览图像，没有输入时安静待着而不是报错。 |
| **LC Preview Mask 🎭** | 预览 mask，没有输入时安静待着而不是报错。 |
| **🧩LC Prompt Assembler** | 把提示词构建的各部分（主体、相机、光照、风格、场景）组装成一个提示词或 JSON。 |
| **LC Prompt to Conditioning + Zero** | 把提示词编码为 conditioning，同时输出一份归零的副本用作负面。 |
| **LC Reference Latent** | 给 conditioning 附加最多八个参考 latent。 |
| **LC RTX Super Resolution ⚡** | NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution，用于图片或视频帧：最高放大 4 倍，放大干净的源，去噪或去模糊。质量 LOW 到 ULTRA，按倍数或百万像素，可调强度。缺少 nvidia-vfx 时会显示 Install RTX support 按钮。 |
| **LC Sampler Configure** | 集中的双段采样器设置：steps、swap 点、detailer steps、denoise、CFG、sampler 和 scheduler。 |
| **LC Sampler Configure (pipe)** | 双段采样器设置，带可选的 pipe 输入和 pipe 输出。 |
| **LC Sampler Configure Pipe Out** | 把 LC_PIPE 拆成 sampler configure 的各个接口，另加 latent。 |
| **LC Sampler Configure Simple** | 单段采样器设置，只有一个 CFG，没有 step swap。 |
| **LC Sampler Configure Simple (pipe)** | 从 LC_PIPE 读取并写入的简易采样器设置。 |
| **LC Sampler Scheduler ⚙️** | 只选一次 sampler 和 scheduler，接到每个 KSampler 上，让它们一起变化。 |
| **LC Save Image 💾** | 保存带工作流元数据的图像，与 LC Save Metadata 搭配时还带 CivitAI 参数。 |
| **LC Save Metadata 🏷️** | 构建 LC Save Image 写入的元数据（模型、AIR 或 URL、设置）。 |
| **📝 LC Save Text** | 把文本字符串写入输出文件夹中的文件。 |
| **🗒️LC Scene Builder** | 根据场景预设和物体构建场景描述。 |
| **🌱LC Seed** | 一个实用 seed，其模式在只排队运行这个节点时也能工作。 |
| **LC Seed Jump 🌱** | 接收一个 seed 和一个跳跃值，输出该 seed 以及连续五次跳跃后的 seed。 |
| **LC Sharpen Pro** | 消除模糊（反卷积），带质感和清晰度、光晕控制和皮肤保护。有照片、线稿、动漫和插画预设。 |
| **LC Show Any 🔤** | 在节点上显示任意值，并原样透传，类型不变。 |
| **LC Show Text 🔤** | 在节点上显示字符串并继续传递。 |
| **LC Sigma Curve** | 在节点上画自定义 sigma 曲线，保存并重复使用。 |
| **LC Sigma Resample** | 把 sigma 曲线重采样到新的步数，同时保留起始和结束 sigma（也注册为 LCChangeStepCount）。 |
| **LC Sigmas (BETA)** | 一个调度器同时适用于单段和两段采样：sigma 曲线预设（base、beta、flowmatch、hyperbolic、gaussian、你保存的曲线），可以拖动图形来弯曲曲线；还有 step swap、denoise、第二段的 continue 或 renoise，以及 sigma shift。支持常规以及 RES4LYF / ClownShark 的 sampler 名称。 |
| **LC Size Pad 📐** | 宽 x 高的二维滑块：拖动框的角。模型预设（MiniMax H3、Krea 2、SDXL、LTX、Klein 9B、Wan 2.2）会吸附到该模型的步长，并停在它的百万像素上限；带宽高比锁定和竖/横翻转。 |
| **LC Skin Beauty ✨** | 在 LAB 色彩空间里用预设让皮肤变冷、变亮、更均匀，保护高光，可选 mask。可在 GPU 或 CPU 上运行。 |
| **LC Skin Texture ✨ (BETA)** | 用真实皮肤照片给太光滑的皮肤添加真实的毛孔质感（只取它的细微起伏，绝不取颜色）。可选的 protect_mask 会避开 detailer 处理过的区域。 |
| **LC Skin Upscale** | 只用 CNN 模型放大 mask 内的皮肤区域，再混合回去。可选的 protect_mask 会避开 detailer 处理过的区域。 |
| **LC Slider** | 节点表面上的滑块，输出 int 或 float。 |
| **LC Speed Boost (BETA) 🚀** | 采样速度约快 2 倍（SDXL / Pony / Illustrious 约 1.4 倍），质量相同：图片从一半大小开始，在中途放大到完整尺寸。接到 high pass sampler 上。 |
| **LC Speed Boost 🚀 KSampler (BETA)** | 内置 Speed Boost 的 KSampler。输入相同，另有 start / end at step，可以串联到另一个 sampler。支持 ClownShark (RES4LYF) 采样器。 |
| **LC Split Sigma Scheduler** | 把 sigmas 在两个模型之间拆分，用于双模型 SamplerCustomAdvanced。 |
| **LC Split Sigmas (Advanced)** | 在 swap step 处把 sigma 曲线拆成高、低两组。 |
| **LC Stop 🛑** | 一个队列断点，启用后会暂停，直到你点继续。 |
| **🗒️LC Style Selector** | 为提示词选择风格预设（和质量等级），并加上你自己的备注。 |
| **🗒️LC Subject** | 用自由文本加上姿势、动作、服装和位置选项来描述提示词的主体。 |
| **🗒️LC Subject Array** | 把多个主体输出合并成一行。 |
| **LC Text Overlay** | 在图像上绘制文字，可拖动位置，可调字号和颜色。 |
| **LC Text Remove 🔪** | 按顺序从文本中删除最多二十个子串。 |
| **LC ✂️ Duplicate Tags 🏷️** | 删除重复的标签，避免权重翻倍（long_hair = (long hair:1.2)）。可选第二个提示词，用于合并两个并一起清理。 |
| **LC 🚦** | boolean 的指示灯：true 一种颜色，false 一种颜色（或无）。颜色在齿轮里设置。 |
| **LC Text Replace ✂️** | 对文本执行最多二十组查找替换（可选正则）。 |
| **LC Timer ⏱️** | 给每次运行计时，并把最新一次与之前 5 次比较打分：更快显示绿色，更慢显示红色。列出最近 10 次运行。被停止的和完全命中缓存的运行不计入。 |
| **LC Tone Match** | 保留参考图的整体光线和色彩，同时保留图像自身的精细细节，可选 mask。 |
| **LC Vibrance** | 智能饱和度（vibrance），可选普通饱和度和皮肤保护。 |
| **LC Vignette** | 使图像边缘变暗或变亮。 |
| **LC VRAM Cache Clear** | 一个直通节点，运行时清理 GPU 和模型缓存，即使挂在后面没有任何东西的独立分支上也能工作。 |
| **LC Watermark 💧** | 合成一张可拖动定位的水印图像，实时调整大小和不透明度。透明 PNG 通过 watermark_mask 保留其透明度。 |
| **LC Widget To String** | 把另一个节点上的控件读取为字符串。 |
| **🎲LC Wildcard** | 从 wildcard 文本文件中随机取一行。 |
| **Prompt** | 提示词文本框（原名 LC Positive）。Vision Assistant 会用它替换其他包的文本框，如果文本框接的是负面，则替换成 LC Negative。 |
| **Prompt to Conditioning** | 把文本提示词编码为 CLIP conditioning。 |

## LC AV v0.3.13

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_AV_nodes)

| 节点 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **LC Audio Channel 🎚️** | 把立体声音频拆成左右声道，并把单声道复制到两边。 |
| **LC Audio Crop ✂️** | 从起始时间到结束时间裁剪音频（MM:SS）。 |
| **LC Audio Duration ⏱️** | 以秒和分钟、int 和 float 输出音频长度。 |
| **LC Audio EQ 3-Band 🎛️** | 三段均衡器，包含低架、峰值中频和高架。 |
| **LC Audio Separate 🎼** | 用 Hybrid Demucs 把音频拆分成 Bass、Drums、Other 和 Vocals 分轨。 |
| **LC Audio Volume 🔊** | 用滑块改变音量，增益之后做软削波。 |
| **LC AV Pipe (in/edit) 🎬** | 打包或编辑包含视频、音频和设置的 LC_AV_PIPE。 |
| **LC AV Pipe Out 🎬** | 把 LC_AV_PIPE 拆成各个槽位，并继续传递 av_pipe。 |
| **LC Create Video 🎬** | 从图像批量构建 LC_AV_PIPE（不会编码文件）。 |
| **LC Final Frame 🖼️** | 输出图像批量的最后一帧。 |
| **LC Get Latent Size 📐** | 读取 latent 的像素宽高，视频 latent 还包括批量和帧数。 |
| **LC Load Audio 📂** | 从 input 文件夹加载音频，带起止裁剪和预览播放器。 |
| **LC Pipe → AV Pipe 🔌** | 把 LC_PIPE 或 MiniMax H3 pipe 转换成 LC_AV_PIPE，只复制共有的字段。 |
| **LC Save Video Metadata 🏷️** | 构建与 LC Save Metadata 相同的元数据，用于 LC Save Image 或 LC Save Video。 |
| **LC Save Video 💾** | 保存视频，带 Video Combine 风格的选项（帧率、循环、格式、pingpong、crf、pix_fmt、音频）。 |
| **LC VAE Decode 🧩** | 带有完整解码与分块解码切换的 VAE Decode。 |

## LC MaskMaker v0.19.8

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_MaskMaker_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_MaskMaker_nodes)

| 节点 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **LC Auto Adjust 🔆** | 一键自动色阶（按通道、亮度、饱和度或单色），带修剪、混合强度和可选 mask。 |
| **LC Create Mask 🖼️✏️** | 直接在节点上用点或自由铅笔绘制 mask，内置羽化、反转和不透明度。 |
| **LC Depth Anything V2 🌊** | 生成 Depth Anything V2 深度图（越亮越近），输出为图像和 mask。模型列表在每台机器上都一样。 |
| **LC Face Crop 📐** | 裁剪成指定格式，并把人脸放在合适的位置，而不是盲目居中裁剪，使用 Aspect Ratio Simplifier 的预设。取景从最宽到仅脸部。 |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | 把图层放在背景上（位置、缩放、旋转、镜像），并通过可选 mask 用 29 种混合模式混合。 |
| **LC Outpaint, Rotate, & Pad 🔄** | 在节点上拖动来旋转、裁剪和填充图片，带竖/横翻转。mask 覆盖填充区域和旋转后露出的角。max_megapixels 会把画面限制在该尺寸。 |
| **LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹** | 使用 AnyPaint LoRA 的 Krea 2 inpaint 和 outpaint。mask 之外的一切原样返回，接缝消失。 |
| **LC Z-Image AnyPaint 🩹** | 针对 Z-Image（Turbo / Base）的同样的 inpaint 和 outpaint，由 Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1 patch 而不是 LoRA 来绘制。mask 之外的一切原样返回。 |
| **LC SDXL AnyPaint 🩹** | 针对任意 SDXL checkpoint（SDXL、Pony、Illustrious）的同样的 inpaint 和 outpaint，由 ControlNet Union ProMax 绘制，Fooocus inpaint 可选。不需要 LoRA。 |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | 用 trimap 收紧 mask，只在边缘带使用 guided filter 或 VITMatte，带前后对比滑动。 |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | 生成 BAE 表面法线图（RGB = XYZ），与 ControlNet 的 normal_bae 生成的风格相同。 |
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | 在节点上向外拖动画布边缘，构建灰色画布和新增区域的 mask。max_megapixels 会把边缘限制在该尺寸。 |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | 用 Segformer 或 MediaPipe 选择人物的各个部分（脸、头发、身体、衣服、配饰、背景）。remove_features 可生成仅皮肤的 mask。 |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | 用 BiRefNet 移除背景，输出 RGBA 抠图、mask 以及纯色背景上的主体。 |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | 通过描述来选择物体，使用 GroundingDINO + SAM 或 SAM 3，可选边缘细化。 |
| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | 取代 SEGS / Impact detailers。用 SAM 3 找到你输入的东西（手、脸、眼睛），在各自放大的裁剪区里重绘，然后混合回去。 |
| **LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹** | 同上，模型、VAE 和采样器设置来自 LC pipe。接入的模型或 VAE 会覆盖 pipe 里的。 |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | 内置 VOSR 2.0 的快速、低 VRAM 放大：锐化并添加精细细节，而不重绘画面。一次 1.5 倍到 4 倍，两次可到 6 倍和 8 倍。 |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩** | 同上，用于 LC pipe，放在 pipe detailers 之后。把 detailers 的区域带到新尺寸（protected 输出），供 LC Skin Upscale / LC Skin Texture 使用。 |

## LC Vision v1.5.1

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes)

| 节点 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **LC Vision Director (BETA) 🎬** | 把长的 MiniMax H3 视频规划成一连串 CUT / CONTINUE 片段，共用一个风格块，由 LC H3 Segment 节点每次 Run 生成一个。保存计划并可重复使用。 |
| **LC Vision Reviewer 🕵️ (BETA)** | 质量关卡：对手、脸、文字、伪影、提示词匹配以及你自己的问题做是/否检查。标记不合格的渲染，或阻止它后面的一切。 |
| **LC Vision Shot List (BETA) 📋** | 给 Director 的故事，像填表一样填写：地点、角色和每个镜头一行。建议片段数量，并对太长而放不进镜头的台词发出警告。不涉及 AI。 |
| **LC Vision Redirect (BETA) 🔬** | 查看上一个片段实际是怎么结束的，并改写下一个片段的开头来匹配，这样衔接处就不会有人瞬移。 |
| **LC Vision Danbooru Caption 🏷️** | 从一张图或一个粗略的想法生成 SDXL、Pony 和 Illustrious 的提示词：简短或详细的描述、真实的 Danbooru 标签，或一句话加标签。可选质量标签和匹配的负面提示词。 |
| **LC Vision Caption 📝** | 用已加载的 LC Vision 模型、一条指令、最多三张参考图和一个参考视频生成文本。 |
| **LC Vision Loader 🔬** | 加载 Qwen-VL GGUF 模型及其视觉投影器。关闭 keep_model_loaded 会在 Vision 节点用完后卸载它，让图像模型独享整张显卡。 |
| **LC Vision Moviemaker 🎥** | 一次调用把视频规划成若干连续片段，每个都写成独立完整的 MiniMax H3 提示词。 |
| **LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝** | 使用预设指令，通过 LC Vision 模型改写提示词（仅文本）。 |

## LC ModelBuilder v0.6.1

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes)

| 节点 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **LC Checkpoint Save** | 保存一体式 checkpoint（model、clip、vae），带 enabled 开关可跳过保存。metadata：保留全部，或仅保留必要信息（不含工作流或训练细节）。 |
| **LC Diffusion Model Save** | 只保存 diffusion 模型，不含 clip 或 vae。同样的 metadata 开关。 |
| **LC Face Variety Scorer 🧑‍🤝‍🧑** | 给一批图像里的人脸有多相似打分（0 到 1，越低 = 越多样），并为合照给出人群得分。有真人照片（ArcFace）或动漫（CCIP）模式。 |
| **LC Fingerprint Identify 🔎** | 这个模型是由什么构成的？根据你的指纹库给出它的配方，逐 block 分析：合并了哪些模型、比例多少，融入的 LoRA 及其强度，对每一项有多大把握，还有热力图。它只能说出库里有的东西。 |
| **LC Fingerprint Library 📚** | 遍历你的文件夹，为每个模型和 LoRA 保存一个小小的指纹（约 1 MB）及其所属家族。文件入库之后，原文件就可以删除。重新运行只会添加新的。 |
| **LC Krea2 Block Merge Advanced** | 合并 Krea2 checkpoint，在 28 个 block 上使用可拖动的逐 block 比例曲线，另有命名区域的滑块。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Block Scan** | 通过逐个关闭 block 组，找出 LoRA 在哪里锁定了人脸或改变了整张图，并为 Editor 推荐 block 曲线。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Editor** | 加载 Krea 2 LoRA，可对 28 个 block 逐个调高或调低，分别缩放 attention 和 MLP，并柔化尖峰。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Merge** | 用逐 block 的 A / B 曲线（sum 或 TIES）合并两到四个 Krea 2 LoRA。 |
| **LC Krea2 Semantic Vector Tuner** | 放大或减弱单个 Krea2 checkpoint 权重的特定区域（不是 merge）。 |
| **LC LoRA Extract** | 把 finetune 变成 LoRA（finetune 减去它的 base）：所有层、仅 block 或自定义 block 列表。未改变的层会被排除。 |
| **LC LoRA Save** | 把编辑或合并后的 LoRA 保存为标准文件，所有编辑都已烘焙进去，可选新的 rank，带 enabled 和 embed_workflow 开关。 |
| **LC Model Fingerprint 🔍** | 从权重本身出发，逐层比较一个模型与一个参考：是另一种精度的同一模型、基于它构建的、block merge（图表显示是哪些 block）还是无关。对 LoRA：它是否被合并进去，以及大约的强度。 |
| **LC Model Quantize 🗜️** | 保存模型的较小副本：fp8、mxfp8、nvfp4、int8 或 int4（用原生加载器加载）或 GGUF Q8_0 到 Q2_K。可来自接入的 MODEL（已烘焙 LoRA），或直接来自任意大小的文件。 |
| **LC Model Merge (any precision)** | 合并以不同精度存储的两个模型（bf16 与 fp8、int8、nvfp4 或 GGUF，顺序不限）。结果保持全精度。 |
| **LC Scoreboard 🏆** | A / B 测试的对决计数器：#1 Win、Tie 和 #2 Win 按钮，领先者和百分比显示在节点上。 |
| **LC Strip Metadata 🧹** | 清除你已保存模型里的元数据（内嵌工作流、训练细节、标题）。权重逐字节复制，从不加载，所以加载效果和之前完全一样。写出 _clean 副本，或替换原文件。 |
| **LC VAE Compare** | 用最多六个 VAE 解码相同的 latent，并排显示 1:1 细节裁剪、锐度数值，以及每个与第一个的差距。 |
| **LC VAE Merge** | 合并同一家族的两个 VAE 的解码器，从粗略形状到精细质感。编码器仍是 base 的，所以结果依然适配为它制作的模型。 |
| **LC VAE Save** | 以 fp32、bf16 或 fp16 把 VAE 保存到 models/vae。 |

---

## LC123 v1.50.0

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

| ノード | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **CivitAI 🚩🔪** | コンプライアンスリストを使って、プロンプトからフラグの付いた用語を取り除きます。あくまで補助です(CivitAI の規約に対する責任は自分にあります)。オンにするまでは動きません。 |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | Image Saver 系のノード向けに、ファイル名とパスを別々に出力します。パスにプレフィックスを入れる機能とタイムスタンプも任意で付けられます。 |
| **LC Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | ノード上に RGB の領域を塗ると、Anima のリージョナルプロンプト用に、領域ごとの conditioning とマスクが得られます。 |
| **LC Any Empty Bool** | 接続された入力のどれかが空、ミュート、またはバイパスされていれば true を出力します。 |
| **LC Any Empty Float** | Any Empty Bool と同じ空チェックを行い、空のときと空でないときの float を出力します。 |
| **LC Any Empty Int** | Any Empty Bool と同じ空チェックを行い、空のときと空でないときの整数を出力します。 |
| **LC Any Index Switch** | 選んだインデックスの入力を通し、他のスロットは無視します。 |
| **LC AnySwitch** | 2〜20個の入力のうち、最初に接続されているものを選び、その型にロックします。 |
| **LC Apply LoRA Stack 🎚️** | LC LoRA Loader Stack(または他のパック)の LORA_STACK を、model と clip のどちらか、または両方に適用します。 |
| **LC Apply LUT** | models/luts の .cube 3D LUT を、0 から 2 の strength で適用します。LC Crushed Blacks の 0.3 から始まります。 |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe (In/Edit)** | image、mask、size、latent、batch、resolution を LC_PIPE にまとめるか、既存のものを編集します。配線したソケットだけを上書きします。 |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe Out** | LC_PIPE のアスペクト比関連のフィールドを個別のソケットに展開し、パイプもそのまま次へ渡します。 |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier** | 画像やマスクを目標サイズにリサイズして、image、mask、size、空の latent、batch を出力します。 |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier (pipe)** | Aspect Ratio Simplifier と同じことをして、Get/Set 用の pipe 出力を追加します。 |
| **LC Auto White Balance** | ホワイトバランスを自動補正します。アルゴリズムの選択、strength のブレンド、before/after のワイプが付いています。 |
| **LC Basic Scheduler** | 全ステップ数の sigmas を出力します(denoise なし)。デュアルパスのサンプリング用に、LC Split Sigmas (Advanced) へ渡す目的で作られています。 |
| **LC Batch Image 🖼️** | 自動で増えるスロットから画像をバッチにします。ミュートされたものや欠けたものは無視し、2枚目以降は1枚目のサイズに合わせてリサイズします。 |
| **LC Bloom** | 明るい部分からグローを足します。Bloom、Pro-Mist(ディフュージョンフィルター)、Halation(フィルムの縁のグロー)の各モードがあります。 |
| **LC Boolean** | boolean、int、float をきれいな true/false に変換して、ノード上に表示します。 |
| **LC Boolean Flip** | トグルの反対を出力します。 |
| **LC Boolean Switch** | boolean に応じて、on_true または on_false の入力(型は何でも)を選びます。 |
| **LC Boolean Value** | どこにでも配線できる、シンプルな boolean トグルです。 |
| **LC Bypass Relay** | 左側のノードをまとめて、ハブから OPT_CONNECTION 経由で一斉にミュートまたはバイパスできるようにします。 |
| **LC Bypasser** | リンクされたノードを、トグルまたは BOOLEAN 入力で1か所からバイパスします。 |
| **LC Bypasser Panel** | LC Bypasser、LC Mute、LC Groups Bypasser のための、widget だけのリモコンです。 |
| **🗒️LC Camera** | 距離とアングルのプリセットから、プロンプト用のカメラフレーミングと被写界深度を設定します。 |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | RGB チャンネルをずらして、レンズの色にじみを再現します。チャンネルごとにピクセル量と方向を指定できます。 |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | 画像の色を参照に合わせます(AdaIN / mean-std)。肌の保護とマスクは任意です。 |
| **🎨LC Color Palette** | プリセットまたは画像から、4〜6色のパレットを選び、プロンプトで使えるようにします。 |
| **LC Combo Selector** | 他のノードのコンボ(sampler、scheduler など)につなぐと、その選択肢を写したドロップダウンになります。 |
| **LC Control Panel 🎛️** | 1つのノードに最大16個のスライダーとオン/オフスイッチをまとめ、それぞれが専用の出力を持ちます。行の歯車で、タイプ(数値か boolean)、名前、範囲、ステップ、INT か FLOAT を設定します。数値や boolean の入力につないだ新しい行は、その入力の設定をコピーします。 |
| **LC Custom Combo** | 自分用の選択肢リストを作り、選んだテキストとそのインデックスを出力します。 |
| **LC Custom Combo Panel** | 別の場所から LC Custom Combo の選択を切り替える、リモコンです。 |
| **LC Denoise 💉** | サンプラーに渡すのと同じ denoise を使って、1 から denoise 値を引いた量に応じた latent ノイズを注入します。 |
| **LC Depth FX 🌫️** | 深度マップを使って、大気の霞、light wrap、本物のボケを持つ被写界深度を加えます。looks を共有します。 |
| **LC Detail Daemon (BETA)** | ステップの一定範囲で、モデルからノイズを少し隠すことで、細かいディテールを足します。元の Detail Daemon のスケジュールに基づきます。look only(デフォルト)、classic、keep structure の各モードがあります。サンプラー版です。low pass サンプラーに付けます。 |

| **LC Save Video 💾** | Video Combine と同様のオプション(フレームレート、ループ、フォーマット、pingpong、crf、pix_fmt、音声)で動画を保存します。 |
| **LC VAE Decode 🧩** | フルデコードとタイルデコードを切り替えられる VAE Decode です。 |

## LC MaskMaker v0.19.8

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_MaskMaker_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_MaskMaker_nodes)

| ノード | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **LC Auto Adjust 🔆** | ワンクリックの自動レベル補正です(チャンネルごと、輝度、彩度、モノクロ)。トリム、strength のブレンド、任意のマスク付き。 |
| **LC Create Mask 🖼️✏️** | ポイントまたはフリーハンドのペンシルで、ノード上に直接マスクを描きます。feather、invert、opacity が組み込まれています。 |
| **LC Depth Anything V2 🌊** | Depth Anything V2 の深度マップ(明るい = 近い)を、画像とマスクとして作ります。モデルのリストはどのマシンでも同じに表示されます。 |
| **LC Face Crop 📐** | 闇雲な中央クロップではなく、顔をうまく配置した形でフォーマットにクロップします。Aspect Ratio Simplifier のプリセットを使います。フレーミングは最も広いものから顔のみまで。 |
| **LC Image Blend Advance 🎚️** | レイヤーを背景に配置し(位置、スケール、回転、ミラー)、29種類のブレンドモードで、任意のマスクを通してブレンドします。 |
| **LC Outpaint, Rotate, & Pad 🔄** | ノード上でドラッグして、画像を回転、クロップ、パディングします。縦/横の切り替え付き。マスクは、パディング部分と、回転で開いた角を覆います。max_megapixels でそのサイズでフレームが止まります。 |
| **LC Krea2 AnyPaint 🩹** | AnyPaint LoRA を使った Krea 2 の inpaint と outpaint です。マスクの外側は完全に元のまま戻り、継ぎ目も消えます。 |
| **LC Z-Image AnyPaint 🩹** | Z-Image (Turbo / Base) 向けの同じ inpaint と outpaint で、LoRA の代わりに Z-Image Fun ControlNet Union 2.1 パッチで描きます。マスクの外側は完全に元のまま戻ります。 |
| **LC SDXL AnyPaint 🩹** | 任意の SDXL checkpoint(SDXL、Pony、Illustrious)向けの同じ inpaint と outpaint で、ControlNet Union ProMax で描きます。Fooocus inpaint は任意です。LoRA は不要です。 |
| **LC Mask Refine ✨** | trimap を使ってマスクを引き締めます。エッジのバンドだけにガイデッドフィルターまたは VITMatte を使い、before/after のワイプ付き。 |
| **LC Normal Map (BAE) 🗺️** | BAE のサーフェスノーマルマップ(RGB = XYZ)を作ります。ControlNet の normal_bae が作るものと同じ種類です。 |
| **LC Outpaint 🖌️➕** | ノード上でキャンバスの端を外側にドラッグして、グレーのキャンバスと新しい領域のマスクを作ります。max_megapixels でそのサイズで端が止まります。 |
| **LC Person Mask 🧍** | Segformer または MediaPipe で、人物の部位(顔、髪、体、服、アクセサリー、背景)を選択します。remove_features で肌だけのマスクになります。 |
| **LC Remove Background ✂️** | BiRefNet で背景を除去し、RGBA の切り抜き、マスク、単色背景上の被写体を出力します。 |
| **LC Segment Anything 🎯** | 言葉で説明したものを選択します。GroundingDINO + SAM または SAM 3 を使い、エッジのリファインは任意です。 |
| **LC Smart Detailer 🩹** | SEGS / Impact のディテーラーの代わりになります。入力したもの(手、顔、目)を SAM 3 で見つけ、それぞれをアップスケールしたクロップ内で描き直して、元に戻してブレンドします。 |
| **LC Smart Detailer (pipe) 🩹** | 同じもので、model、VAE、サンプラー設定を LC pipe から受け取ります。配線した model や VAE はパイプのものを上書きします。 |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale 🧩** | 内蔵された VOSR 2.0 による、高速で低 VRAM のアップスケールです: 画像を描き直さずに、シャープにして細かいディテールを足します。1.5倍から4倍は1パスで、6倍と8倍は2パスです。 |
| **LC VOSR2 Upscale (pipe) 🧩** | LC pipe 上で、pipe のディテーラーの後に使う同じものです。ディテーラーの領域を新しいサイズに引き継ぎ(protected 出力)、LC Skin Upscale / LC Skin Texture で使えるようにします。 |

## LC Vision v1.5.1

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_Vision_nodes)

| ノード | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **LC Vision Director (BETA) 🎬** | 長尺の MiniMax H3 動画を、共通のスタイルブロックを持つ CUT / CONTINUE セグメントのチェーンとして計画します。セグメントは LC H3 Segment ノードにより、1回の Run につき1つ作られます。計画を保存して再利用します。 |
| **LC Vision Reviewer 🕵️ (BETA)** | 品質ゲートです: 手、顔、テキスト、アーティファクト、プロンプトとの一致、そして自分の質問について yes/no でチェックします。悪いレンダリングにフラグを立てるか、その後ろのすべてをブロックします。 |
| **LC Vision Shot List (BETA) 📋** | Director 用のストーリーを、フォームのように入力します: 場所、キャスト、ショットごとに1行。セグメント数を提案し、ショットに対して長すぎるセリフを警告します。AI は使いません。 |
| **LC Vision Redirect (BETA) 🔬** | 直前のセグメントが実際にどう終わったかを見て、次のセグメントの冒頭をそれに合わせて書き直すので、つなぎ目で誰かがテレポートすることがなくなります。 |
| **LC Vision Danbooru Caption 🏷️** | 1枚の画像またはざっくりしたアイデアから、SDXL、Pony、Illustrious 用のプロンプトを作ります: 短いまたは詳細なキャプション、本物の Danbooru タグ、または文章 + タグ。品質タグと対応する negative は任意です。 |
| **LC Vision Caption 📝** | 読み込んだ LC Vision モデル、指示、最大3枚の参照画像と参照動画から、テキストを生成します。 |
| **LC Vision Loader 🔬** | Qwen-VL の GGUF モデルとその vision projector を読み込みます。keep_model_loaded をオフにすると、Vision ノードが終わった後にアンロードされるので、画像モデルがカードを丸ごと使えます。 |
| **LC Vision Moviemaker 🎥** | 動画を、複数の連続したセグメントとして1回の呼び出しで計画します。それぞれが単体で完結した MiniMax H3 プロンプトとして書かれます。 |
| **LC Vision Prompt Enhancer 📝** | プリセットの指示を使い、LC Vision モデルを通してプロンプトを書き換えます(テキストのみ)。 |

## LC ModelBuilder v0.6.1

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC_ModelBuilder_nodes)

| ノード | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **LC Checkpoint Save** | オールインワンの checkpoint(model、clip、vae)を保存します。enabled トグルで保存をスキップできます。metadata: すべて保持、または必要最小限のみ(ワークフローや学習の詳細なし)。 |
| **LC Diffusion Model Save** | clip や vae なしで、diffusion model だけを保存します。metadata のスイッチは同じです。 |
| **LC Face Variety Scorer 🧑‍🤝‍🧑** | バッチ内の顔がどれだけ似ているかをスコア化します(0 から 1、低いほど多様)。集合写真用の crowd スコアも出ます。写真(ArcFace)またはアニメ(CCIP)モード。 |
| **LC Fingerprint Identify 🔎** | このモデルは何でできている? fingerprint ライブラリをもとに、ブロックごとのレシピを出します: どのモデルがどの比率でマージされたか、マージされた LoRA とその strength、それぞれにどれだけ確信があるか、そしてヒートマップ。ライブラリにあるものしか名前を挙げられません。 |
| **LC Fingerprint Library 📚** | フォルダーを巡回して、すべてのモデルと LoRA の小さな fingerprint(約 1 MB)をファミリーと一緒に保存します。一度登録すれば元のファイルは消せます。再実行では新しいものだけが追加されます。 |
| **LC Krea2 Block Merge Advanced** | 28ブロックにわたるドラッグ可能なブロックごとの比率カーブと、名前付き領域のスライダーで、Krea2 の checkpoint をマージします。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Block Scan** | ブロックグループを1つずつオフにして、LoRA が顔を固定している場所や画像全体を変えている場所を見つけ、Editor 用のブロックカーブを提案します。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Editor** | 28ブロックそれぞれを上げ下げし、attention と MLP を別々にスケールして、スパイクを和らげた状態で Krea 2 の LoRA を読み込みます。 |
| **LC Krea2 LoRA Merge** | 2〜4個の Krea 2 LoRA を、ブロックごとの A / B カーブ(sum または TIES)でマージします。 |
| **LC Krea2 Semantic Vector Tuner** | 単一の Krea2 checkpoint の重みの特定領域を増幅または減衰します(マージではありません)。 |
| **LC LoRA Extract** | finetune を LoRA に変換します(finetune から base を引いたもの): 全レイヤー、ブロックのみ、またはカスタムのブロックリスト。変化のないレイヤーは含まれません。 |
| **LC LoRA Save** | 編集またはマージした LoRA を、すべての編集を焼き込んだ標準ファイルとして保存します。新しい rank にもできます。enabled と embed_workflow のスイッチ付き。 |
| **LC Model Fingerprint 🔍** | 1つのモデルを、重みそのものから、リファレンスと層ごとに比べます: 別の精度の同じモデル、それをベースに作られたもの、ブロックマージ(チャートでどのブロックかが分かります)、または無関係。LoRA の場合は、マージされているかどうかと、おおよその strength。 |
| **LC Model Quantize 🗜️** | モデルの小さなコピーを保存します: fp8、mxfp8、nvfp4、int8、int4(標準のローダーで読み込めます)または GGUF の Q8_0 から Q2_K。配線した MODEL(LoRA を焼き込み済み)から、または任意のサイズのファイルから直接作れます。 |
| **LC Model Merge (any precision)** | 異なる精度で保存された2つのモデルをマージします(bf16 と fp8、int8、nvfp4、GGUF、どちらの順でも)。結果はフル精度のままです。 |
| **LC Scoreboard 🏆** | A / B テスト用の直接対決カウンターです: #1 Win、Tie、#2 Win のボタンがあり、リーダーとパーセンテージがノード上に表示されます。 |
| **LC Strip Metadata 🧹** | すでに保存したモデルから、メタデータ(埋め込みワークフロー、学習の詳細、タイトル)を消去します。重みはバイト単位でコピーされ、読み込まれることはないので、以前とまったく同じように読み込めます。_clean コピーを書き出すか、元のファイルを置き換えます。 |
| **LC VAE Compare** | 同じ latent を最大6つの VAE でデコードし、1:1 のディテールクロップ、シャープネスの数値、最初のものからどれだけ離れているかを並べて表示します。 |
| **LC VAE Merge** | 同じファミリーの2つの VAE のデコーダーを、大まかな形から細かいテクスチャまでマージします。エンコーダーはベースのものが残るので、結果はそれ用のモデルにもそのまま合います。 |
| **LC VAE Save** | VAE を models/vae に fp32、bf16、fp16 で保存します。 |

---

## LC123 v1.50.0

[github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)

| 노드 | 기능 |
|---|---|
| **CivitAI 🚩🔪** | 컴플라이언스 목록을 사용해 프롬프트에서 문제가 되는 용어를 제거합니다. 보조 수단일 뿐이며 (CivitAI 약관에 대한 책임은 여전히 본인에게 있습니다) 켜기 전에는 꺼져 있습니다. |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | Image Saver 스타일 노드를 위해 파일 이름과 경로 출력을 따로 만들며, 경로에 접두사 넣기와 타임스탬프 옵션이 있습니다. |
| **LC Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | 노드 위에 RGB 영역을 칠하면 영역별로 개별 conditioning과 마스크가 나옵니다. Anima 영역 프롬프트용입니다. |
| **LC Any Empty Bool** | 연결된 입력 중 하나라도 비어 있거나 뮤트 또는 바이패스되어 있으면 true를 출력합니다. |
| **LC Any Empty Float** | Any Empty Bool과 같은 빈 값 검사를 하고, 비었을 때의 float와 비어 있지 않을 때의 float를 출력합니다. |
| **LC Any Empty Int** | Any Empty Bool과 같은 빈 값 검사를 하고, 비었을 때의 정수와 비어 있지 않을 때의 정수를 출력합니다. |
| **LC Any Index Switch** | 선택한 인덱스의 입력을 통과시키고 다른 슬롯은 무시합니다. |
| **LC AnySwitch** | 2개에서 20개의 입력 중 처음으로 연결된 것을 골라 그 타입으로 고정합니다. |
| **LC Apply LoRA Stack 🎚️** | LC LoRA Loader Stack(또는 다른 팩)에서 나온 LORA_STACK을 model 및/또는 clip에 적용합니다. |
| **LC Apply LUT** | models/luts의 .cube 3D LUT을 0에서 2까지의 strength로 적용합니다. 기본으로 LC Crushed Blacks를 0.3으로 시작합니다. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe (In/Edit)** | 이미지, 마스크, 크기, latent, 배치, 해상도를 LC_PIPE로 묶거나 기존 pipe를 수정합니다. 연결한 소켓만 덮어씁니다. |

| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier** | 이미지 및/또는 마스크를 목표 크기로 리사이즈하고 이미지, 마스크, 크기, 빈 latent, 배치를 출력합니다. |
| **📐 LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier (pipe)** | Aspect Ratio Simplifier와 같은 기능에 Get/Set용 pipe 출력이 추가되었습니다. |
| **LC Auto White Balance** | 알고리즘 선택, strength 블렌드, 전/후 와이프로 화이트 밸런스를 자동으로 보정합니다. |

| **LC Boolean Switch** | boolean에 따라 on_true 또는 on_false 입력(아무 타입)을 고릅니다. |
| **LC Boolean Value** | 어디에든 연결할 수 있는 일반 boolean 토글입니다. |

| **LC Bypasser** | 토글 또는 BOOLEAN 입력으로 연결된 노드들을 한 곳에서 바이패스합니다. |
| **LC Bypasser Panel** | LC Bypasser, LC Mute, LC Groups Bypasser용 위젯 전용 리모컨입니다. |
| **🗒️LC Camera** | 거리와 앵글 프리셋으로 프롬프트의 카메라 프레이밍과 피사계 심도를 설정합니다. |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | RGB 채널을 어긋나게 해서 렌즈 색번짐을 흉내 냅니다. 채널별 픽셀 양과 방향을 지정할 수 있습니다. |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | 이미지의 색을 레퍼런스에 맞춥니다 (AdaIN / mean-std). 피부 보호와 마스크는 선택 사항입니다. |
| **🎨LC Color Palette** | 프리셋 또는 이미지에서 프롬프트에 쓸 4-6색 팔레트를 고릅니다. |
| **LC Combo Selector** | 다른 노드의 combo(sampler, scheduler 등)에 연결하면 그 옵션을 그대로 보여 주는 드롭다운입니다. |

| **LC Denoise 💉** | 1에서 denoise 값을 뺀 만큼의 latent 노이즈를 주입합니다. 샘플러에 주는 것과 같은 denoise를 그대로 씁니다. |
| **LC Depth FX 🌫️** | 깊이 맵으로 대기 안개, light wrap, 진짜 보케가 있는 피사계 심도를 만들며 looks를 공유합니다. |

| **LC LoRA Save** | 편집하거나 머지한 LoRA를 모든 편집을 구워 넣은 표준 파일로 저장하며, 새 rank로 저장할 수도 있고 enabled와 embed_workflow 스위치가 있습니다. |
| **LC Model Fingerprint 🔍** | 모델 하나를 레퍼런스와 가중치 자체로 레이어별 비교합니다: 다른 정밀도의 같은 모델인지, 그 위에 만든 것인지, 블록 머지인지(차트에 어떤 블록인지 표시) 아니면 관련이 없는지. LoRA와 함께 쓰면 머지되었는지, 대략 어느 strength였는지 알려 줍니다. |
| **LC Model Quantize 🗜️** | 모델의 더 작은 복사본을 저장합니다: fp8, mxfp8, nvfp4, int8 또는 int4 (기본 로더로 불러오기) 또는 GGUF Q8_0에서 Q2_K. 연결한 MODEL(LoRA 구워 넣음)에서, 또는 어떤 크기의 파일에서든 바로 만들 수 있습니다. |
| **LC Model Merge (any precision)** | 서로 다른 정밀도로 저장된 두 모델을 머지합니다 (bf16과 fp8, int8, nvfp4 또는 GGUF, 순서 무관). 결과는 풀 정밀도로 유지됩니다. |
| **LC Scoreboard 🏆** | A / B 테스트용 대결 카운터: #1 Win, Tie, #2 Win 버튼이 있고 선두와 비율이 노드에 표시됩니다. |
| **LC Strip Metadata 🧹** | 이미 저장한 모델에서 메타데이터(내장 워크플로우, 학습 정보, 제목)를 청소합니다. 가중치는 바이트 단위로 그대로 복사되며 불러오지 않으므로, 이전과 똑같이 로드됩니다. _clean 복사본을 쓰거나 원본을 대체합니다. |
| **LC VAE Compare** | 같은 latent를 최대 여섯 개의 VAE로 디코딩해서, 1:1 디테일 크롭, 선명도 수치, 각각이 첫 번째에서 얼마나 떨어져 있는지와 함께 나란히 보여 줍니다. |
| **LC VAE Merge** | 같은 계열의 두 VAE 디코더를 큰 형태부터 미세한 질감까지 머지합니다. 인코더는 base의 것이 유지되어서, 결과물이 그 VAE용으로 만든 모델에 그대로 맞습니다. |
| **LC VAE Save** | VAE를 fp32, bf16, fp16으로 models/vae에 저장합니다. |
